Team —

Attached is a quick close-velocity heatmap I pulled from Salesforce; it highlights deals that have not advanced stage or updated close date in the last 30 days. We need a rapid reconciliation so Finance can lock the Q2 commit by EOD Monday.

Action requested (48 hours):
- Owners: confirm stage and final close-date OR archive the record if no motion.
- If you need an exception (reason + expected next step), reply with that.
- If a deal is on hold pending customer procurement, cc the customer contact and add a one-line mutual action plan.

Priority accounts flagged (examples):
- ACME Corp — $420k (no stage change since 5/10)
- IonHealth — $180k (close date moved twice)

Please update the Salesforce 'Close Velocity' report and use the comment box so we have a timestamped justification. I will run a follow-up pass Friday morning and escalate any unowned records to managers.

Attachments: close-velocity-heatmap.png (visual), SF-Report: CloseVelocity_Q2_2026

Thanks —
Jonas Weber
Director, Sales Operations
